rule: A dead node-type/field literal is registered BY NAME with an owner and a reason. A literal the record does not name fails. A recorded entry with no reason fails. A recorded literal that disappears fails too: the record is a decision, so a repayment is written down here in the same round that removes it.
_history:
v1 of this file was a per-language COUNT (2026-08-23) and its gate failed only on an increase. That shape hid a real defect: csharp's declared-type round added record_struct_declaration and constraint_clause on 2026-09-22 while an older finding elsewhere was fixed, so the count went 3 -> 2 and the gate read an improvement. v2 (2026-09-23) records each tolerated literal by name, with owner and reason. Counts are kept as a ceiling only. The gate is negative-tested in script/m14/audit-analyzer-grammar.ts (--self-test-gate, 9 assertions), including the exact case that hid the defect: a NEW literal under an improved count.

REPAYMENT RECORDED 2026-09-23 (csharp, C1 of reviews/csharp/m60-completion-plan.md): csharp's two entries were removed from this register in the same commit that removed the literals from src/ast/real-csharp-analyzer.ts — record_struct_declaration and constraint_clause are gone, the kind rule now reads the grammar's UNNAMED struct/class token (measured: `record struct` publishes Struct, was Class), and the constraint-clause arm names the grammar's real `type_parameter_constraints_clause`. csharp's count moved 2 -> 0. Re-introducing either spelling now fails this gate as UNREGISTERED, which is the proof that the repayment is enforced rather than merely written down.

REPAYMENT RECORDED 2026-09-24 (dart, M60 dart lane): dart's two entries are removed in the same round that removed the literals from src/ast/real-dart-analyzer.ts, and each was repaid by MEASUREMENT rather than by renaming. (1) `return_type` was a dead read — the pinned grammar's field set has no such field and a probe over both pinned corpora resolved it on 0 of 117,200 nodes, so the read was deleted and the fallback that always ran is now the only path. (2) `dynamic` was NOT a dead node-type branch at all: it reads a PARAMETER DESCRIPTOR's `.type`, which is a Dart TYPE NAME, and it was the audit's `X.type === "lit"` heuristic that made it look like a node-type reference. It is now the documented constant IMPLICIT_DYNAMIC_TYPE (which is also what an untyped parameter is published as at real-dart-analyzer.ts), so the reference says what it is and the audit is not being taught to skip anything. dart's count moved 2 -> 0. Re-introducing either spelling fails this gate as UNREGISTERED.

REPAYMENT RECORDED 2026-09-26 (r lane, M12/M14 deep review): the single registered R dead literal, the FIELD `default_value`, is GONE. tree-sitter-r names a parameter's default in the `default` FIELD, so `childForFieldName("default_value")` could never return a node; the analyzer fell back to scanning the parameter's raw text for `=`. It now reads `default`, which removes the dead branch AND the text scan AND recovers the default EXPRESSION, which was computed and then discarded (Parameter.defaultValue was never populated). count 1 -> 0, literals.r removed. Evidence: validation/m12/results/r-grammar-conformance.json and the mutation `parameter-default-value-dead-field`.
